summary: Protocol Recommendations feature testing completed. All 18 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified working correctly - recommendation badge shows pending count, View Recommendations modal displays all recommendation details with APPLY CHANGE, REJECT, and DELETE actions.

issues: The 'Suggest Change' lightbulb button only appears for public categories owned by OTHER users. Currently, the category tree only shows the user's own categories, so users cannot suggest changes to other users' public protocols from the Ultimate Search page. The Global Database page shows public categories but doesn't have the suggest change functionality.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Consider adding 'Suggest Change' functionality to the Global Database page where users can see other users' public categories
critical_code_review_comments: Backend API implementation is correct and complete
Frontend components (SuggestChangeModal, ViewRecommendationsModal, RecommendationBadge) are properly implemented
The recommendation badge correctly shows pending count with yellow notification badge
Owner can view, accept, reject, and delete recommendations
Non-owners cannot recommend on their own protocols (400 error)
Non-owners cannot recommend on private protocols (403 error)
seed_data_creation: Created testuser@example.com for testing. Submitted a test recommendation from TestUser to john_selman's 'American Civil War UPDATED' category.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Protocol Recommendations feature fully tested and working. Key verifications: 1) POST /api/categories/{id}/recommendations - submit recommendation (works). 2) GET /api/categories/{id}/recommendations - owner only view (works). 3) GET /api/recommendations/my-protocols - get all recommendations for owner's protocols (works). 4) PUT /api/recommendations/{id}/status - accept/reject (works). 5) DELETE /api/recommendations/{id} - delete (works). 6) GET /api/categories/{id}/recommendations/count - get pending count (works). 7) Cannot recommend on own protocol - 400 (works). 8) Cannot recommend on private protocol - 403 (works). Frontend: RecommendationBadge shows pending count, ViewRecommendationsModal shows all details with APPLY CHANGE, REJECT, DELETE buttons.

submit_recommendation.details: POST /api/categories/{id}/recommendations - User can submit recommendation for public protocols owned by others

cannot_recommend_own_protocol.details: Returns 400 error when user tries to recommend on their own protocol

get_recommendation_count.details: GET /api/categories/{id}/recommendations/count - Returns total and pending count

delete_recommendation.details: DELETE /api/recommendations/{id} - Owner or submitter can delete

recommendation_badge_ui.details: Lightbulb icon with pending count badge appears on Categories page

view_recommendations_modal.details: Modal shows recommendation details with APPLY CHANGE, REJECT, DELETE buttons
